response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with a strong focus on TypeScript, Node.js, and React, aligning well with the primary stack. His roles demonstrate deep expertise in scalable architectures, cloud platforms (AWS), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), along with contributions to AI-agent infrastructure. His background in diverse languages (Kotlin/Java/Python) and testing frameworks (Vitest/Jest) further strengthens his fit. Minor concerns include limited explicit Nest.js experience and a gap in recent employment history, but his track record compensates.
